quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a client strategy team presenting a retention analysis.
options: I AM PLEASED TO REPORT THAT OUR Q3 CHURN RATE HAS FALLEN FROM 14% TO 8% FOLLOWING THE INTRODUCTION OF OUR PROACTIVE ENGAGEMENT PROGRAMME LAUNCHED IN JULY.

BEST REGARDS,
ELLEN WADE, CLIENT DIRECTOR
DEAR CLIENT SUCCESS TEAM,
SUBJECT: CLIENT RETENTION ANALYSIS - Q3 CHURN RATE 8% (DOWN FROM 14%)
quests.hint: The key metric and improvement are in the subject; the team is addressed; before-and-after churn rates and the causal intervention are in the body; director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Showing both the before rate ('14%') and after rate ('8%') and linking the improvement to a specific programme ('proactive engagement launched in July') makes a complete cause-and-effect argument. This is the standard format for a performance report.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to clients asking them to complete a satisfaction survey.
options: WE WOULD GREATLY APPRECIATE TWO MINUTES OF YOUR TIME TO COMPLETE OUR ANNUAL CLIENT SATISFACTION SURVEY - YOUR RESPONSES DIRECTLY SHAPE HOW WE IMPROVE OUR SERVICE TO YOU.
DEAR VALUED CLIENT,

WITH KIND REGARDS,
NEXUS CLIENT SUCCESS TEAM
SUBJECT: YOUR FEEDBACK MATTERS - TWO-MINUTE CLIENT SURVEY
quests.hint: Time commitment and purpose are in the subject; clients are addressed warmly; brevity, direct impact promise, and the benefit to the client are in the body; team signs warmly.
quests.explanation: Two nudges increase survey completion: telling clients it will take only two minutes AND explaining that responses directly affect service quality. The subject line previewing the time commitment ('two-minute') reduces the barrier to clicking.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to senior leaders presenting a client churn analysis and strategy recommendation.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
ELLEN WADE, CLIENT DIRECTOR
OUR ANALYSIS IDENTIFIES THE THREE PRIMARY CAUSES OF CLIENT CHURN AS INADEQUATE ONBOARDING, SLOW RESPONSE TIMES, AND LACK OF PERSONALISED REPORTING - I RECOMMEND ADDRESSING ALL THREE IN Q1.
SUBJECT: CLIENT CHURN ANALYSIS - TOP THREE CAUSES AND RECOMMENDED ACTIONS
DEAR LEADERSHIP TEAM,
quests.hint: Analysis type and number of causes are in the subject; leadership is addressed; three specific churn drivers and a quarter-based action recommendation are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: Naming three specific causes is far more actionable than a vague 'poor service' finding. Ending with 'I recommend addressing all three in Q1' makes the email a recommendation, not just an analysis - more useful to leaders who need to make decisions.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to the board formally requesting approval for next year's budget.
options: I AM REQUESTING BOARD APPROVAL FOR A TOTAL DEPARTMENTAL BUDGET OF £2.4M FOR FINANCIAL YEAR 2025, REPRESENTING A 3.2% INCREASE ON FY2024 TO ACCOMMODATE PLANNED HEADCOUNT GROWTH.

YOURS SINCERELY,
CHRIS FORD, OPERATIONS DIRECTOR
DEAR FINANCE COMMITTEE,
SUBJECT: BUDGET APPROVAL REQUEST - FY2025 DEPARTMENTAL ALLOCATION
quests.hint: Budget type and year are in the subject; the finance committee is addressed formally; total amount, year-on-year increase percentage, and justification (headcount growth) are all in the body; director signs with role.
quests.explanation: A budget request must include three elements: the total requested ('£2.4M'), the percentage change ('3.2% increase'), and the specific justification ('headcount growth'). These three facts enable an informed committee decision.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email presenting a cost reduction plan to senior management.
options: I AM PROPOSING A COST REDUCTION PLAN THAT IDENTIFIES £180,000 IN ANNUAL SAVINGS THROUGH CONSOLIDATING SOFTWARE LICENCES (£60K), RENEGOTIATING SUPPLIER CONTRACTS (£80K), AND REDUCING TRAVEL (£40K).
DEAR MANAGEMENT BOARD,

YOURS SINCERELY,
CHRIS FORD, OPERATIONS DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: COST REDUCTION PLAN - £180,000 ANNUAL SAVING PROPOSAL
quests.hint: Total saving and plan type are in the subject; the board is addressed formally; three specific saving initiatives with individual amounts totalling £180K are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: The most credible cost reduction plan shows individual components that add up to the total - £60K + £80K + £40K = £180K. This breakdown proves the number is real and allows the board to approve or adjust individual elements.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to the finance team presenting a five-year financial forecast.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
CHRIS FORD, OPERATIONS DIRECTOR
I AM PRESENTING OUR FIVE-YEAR FINANCIAL FORECAST WHICH PROJECTS COMPOUND ANNUAL REVENUE GROWTH OF 12%, REACHING £18M BY FY2029, UNDERPINNED BY THE ASSUMPTION OF THREE NEW PRODUCT LAUNCHES.
SUBJECT: FIVE-YEAR FINANCIAL FORECAST - FY2025–2029 PROJECTIONS
DEAR FINANCE COMMITTEE,
quests.hint: Time horizon and forecast purpose are in the subject; finance committee addressed formally; CAGR, absolute revenue target, and assumption basis are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: The three-element forecast formula - growth rate ('12% CAGR'), end-state absolute ('£18M by 2029'), and assumption basis ('three new product launches') - is the standard structure for presenting a credible financial forecast to a committee.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to all staff announcing a team restructure.
options: I AM WRITING TO ANNOUNCE THAT THE OPERATIONS TEAM WILL BE RESTRUCTURED FROM 1 JULY TO BETTER ALIGN OUR CAPABILITIES WITH OUR GROWTH STRATEGY - INDIVIDUAL ROLE CHANGES WILL BE COMMUNICATED IN PERSON.

BEST REGARDS,
CHRIS FORD, OPERATIONS DIRECTOR
DEAR ALL,
SUBJECT: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT - OPERATIONS TEAM RESTRUCTURE FROM 1 JULY
quests.hint: Announcement type and date are in the subject; all staff are addressed; restructure, effective date, strategic rationale, and process for individual communications are in the body; director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Promising that role changes will be communicated 'in person' is critical in restructure announcements - it shows respect for affected employees and prevents rumours from spreading before people receive their news directly.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email formally notifying an employee of their new role following a restructure.
options: AS A RESULT OF THE RESTRUCTURE, YOUR ROLE WILL CHANGE FROM OPERATIONS ANALYST TO SENIOR OPERATIONS SPECIALIST WITH EFFECT FROM 1 JULY - A FULL REVISED JOB DESCRIPTION IS ATTACHED.
DEAR JAMES,

YOURS SINCERELY,
CHRIS FORD, OPERATIONS DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: YOUR NEW ROLE FOLLOWING TEAM RESTRUCTURE - EFFECTIVE 1 JULY
quests.hint: New role and effective date are in the subject; the employee is addressed by name; old role, new role, effective date, and attached job description are all in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: A role change notification must include both the old AND new role titles to be unambiguous. Attaching the revised job description ensures the employee immediately understands their new responsibilities without a follow-up request.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a manager outlining new responsibilities following a restructure.
options:
BEST REGARDS,
CHRIS FORD, DIRECTOR
FOLLOWING THE RESTRUCTURE, YOU WILL TAKE ON DIRECT LINE MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE THREE OPERATIONS ANALYSTS PREVIOUSLY REPORTING TO JAMES BLAKE WITH EFFECT FROM 1 JULY.
SUBJECT: REVISED RESPONSIBILITIES - PEOPLE MANAGEMENT ADDED TO YOUR ROLE
DEAR SARAH,
quests.hint: New responsibility type and role are in the subject; the manager addressed by first name; specific new responsibility, the three team members, their previous line manager, and effective date are all in the body.
quests.explanation: Specifying which team members will now report to Sarah ('the three Operations Analysts previously reporting to James') prevents ambiguity about who is in scope and ensures a smooth reporting line transition.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to an IT board proposing a cloud migration technology upgrade.
options: I AM PROPOSING THE MIGRATION OF OUR CORE INFRASTRUCTURE TO CLOUD-BASED SERVICES, WHICH OUR ANALYSIS PROJECTS WILL DELIVER A 340% ROI OVER THREE YEARS THROUGH REDUCED HARDWARE AND SUPPORT COSTS.

YOURS SINCERELY,
TIM HART, IT DIRECTOR
DEAR TECHNOLOGY BOARD,
SUBJECT: CLOUD MIGRATION PROPOSAL - ESTIMATED ROI 340% OVER THREE YEARS
quests.hint: ROI and proposal type are in the subject; the technology board is addressed formally; migration proposal, ROI figure, time horizon, and cost drivers are in the body; IT director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Leading the subject with the ROI ('340% over three years') rather than the technology ('cloud migration') makes the proposal immediately appealing to a board audience who think in financial terms rather than technical ones.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email outlining a digital transformation roadmap to senior leadership.
options: I AM PRESENTING OUR EIGHTEEN-MONTH DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION ROADMAP, WHICH COVERS THREE PHASES: INFRASTRUCTURE MIGRATION (Q1–Q2), PROCESS AUTOMATION (Q3–Q4), AND AI INTEGRATION (MONTHS 13–18).
DEAR EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE,

YOURS SINCERELY,
TIM HART, IT DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION ROADMAP - 18-MONTH DELIVERY PLAN
quests.hint: Roadmap type and duration are in the subject; the executive committee is addressed formally; three phases with specific quarter-based timelines are in the body; director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Phasing a transformation into three stages with named quarters gives leadership a clear mental picture of sequencing and milestones. The phase names also tell leadership what each stage delivers, which helps them understand the strategic logic.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a board proposing a significant IT infrastructure investment.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
TIM HART, IT DIRECTOR
I AM REQUESTING BOARD APPROVAL FOR AN £890,000 INVESTMENT IN A COMPREHENSIVE CYBERSECURITY UPGRADE, NECESSARY TO ACHIEVE AND MAINTAIN ISO 27001 CERTIFICATION AND PROTECT AGAINST EVOLVING THREATS.
SUBJECT: IT INVESTMENT REQUEST - CYBERSECURITY UPGRADE: £890,000
DEAR BOARD OF DIRECTORS,
quests.hint: Investment amount and type are in the subject; the board is addressed formally; exact cost, two specific justifications (ISO 27001 AND evolving threats) are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: Two compelling justifications for cybersecurity investment - compliance ('ISO 27001') and risk management ('evolving threats') - address the board's two biggest concerns: regulatory exposure and operational security.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to HR presenting a training needs analysis for the sales team.
options: OUR TRAINING NEEDS ANALYSIS IDENTIFIES THREE PRIORITY SKILL GAPS IN THE SALES TEAM: ADVANCED NEGOTIATION, DATA-DRIVEN SELLING, AND DIGITAL PLATFORM PROFICIENCY - I RECOMMEND ADDRESSING ALL THREE IN Q2.

YOURS SINCERELY,
OWEN HARRIS, SALES DIRECTOR
DEAR L&D TEAM,
SUBJECT: TRAINING NEEDS ANALYSIS - SALES TEAM SKILLS GAP REPORT
quests.hint: Training type and team are in the subject; the L&D team is addressed; three specific skill gaps and a quarterly action timeline are in the body; sales director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Three specific skill gaps are more actionable than a general 'needs improvement' finding. Naming them precisely allows L&D to source appropriate training providers or design specific programmes for each gap.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a training provider briefing them for a customised corporate training programme.
options: WE REQUIRE A BESPOKE LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME FOR FORTY FIRST-LINE MANAGERS, COVERING COACHING SKILLS, PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT, AND CHANGE LEADERSHIP - DELIVERY TO BEGIN IN SEPTEMBER.
DEAR PROGRAMME DIRECTOR,

YOURS SINCERELY,
AMY CHEN, HEAD OF LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT
SUBJECT: TRAINING BRIEF - LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME, 40 MANAGERS
quests.hint: Programme type and group size are in the subject; the programme director is addressed formally; exact number, management level, three topics, and start month are in the body; L&D head signs with role.
quests.explanation: A training brief must specify who ('forty first-line managers'), what ('coaching, performance, change'), and when ('September'). These three constraints enable the provider to develop an accurate proposal.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email reporting the outcome of a skills gap assessment to senior leadership.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
AMY CHEN, HEAD OF LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT
OUR COMPANY-WIDE SKILLS GAP ASSESSMENT IDENTIFIED SIX PRIORITY AREAS FOR INVESTMENT, WITH DIGITAL SKILLS AND DATA LITERACY EMERGING AS THE MOST URGENT CROSS-DEPARTMENTAL REQUIREMENTS.
SUBJECT: SKILLS GAP ASSESSMENT RESULTS - SIX KEY GAPS IDENTIFIED COMPANY-WIDE
DEAR LEADERSHIP TEAM,
quests.hint: Assessment type and scale of finding are in the subject; leadership is addressed; total number of gaps and the two most urgent are named in the body; L&D head signs formally.
quests.explanation: When reporting to leadership, naming the total gaps ('six') provides scope, and identifying the two most urgent ('digital skills and data literacy') creates a clear priority for resourcing decisions. More detail belongs in the attached report.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a procurement team launching a new supplier procurement policy.
options: I AM WRITING TO NOTIFY YOU THAT THE UPDATED SUPPLIER PROCUREMENT POLICY WILL TAKE EFFECT ON 1 SEPTEMBER - ALL FUTURE SUPPLIER ONBOARDING MUST FOLLOW THE ATTACHED REVISED PROCEDURE.

YOURS SINCERELY,
HANNA SHAW, CHIEF PROCUREMENT OFFICER
DEAR PROCUREMENT TEAM,
SUBJECT: NEW PROCUREMENT POLICY EFFECTIVE 1 SEPTEMBER - MANDATORY COMPLIANCE
quests.hint: Policy name and date are in the subject; the team is addressed; effective date, scope, and attachment are in the body; CPO signs with role.
quests.explanation: The word 'MANDATORY' in the subject line distinguishes this from optional guidance. The attachment reference ('revised procedure') tells recipients exactly where to find what they need to comply, making action immediate and unambiguous.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a supplier team presenting evaluation criteria for a new vendor selection.
options: THE VENDOR SELECTION PROCESS WILL EVALUATE SUPPLIERS AGAINST FOUR CRITERIA: PRICE (30%), TECHNICAL CAPABILITY (35%), DELIVERY RECORD (25%), AND SUSTAINABILITY CREDENTIALS (10%).
DEAR VENDOR ASSESSMENT TEAM,

YOURS SINCERELY,
HANNA SHAW, CHIEF PROCUREMENT OFFICER
SUBJECT: VENDOR SELECTION CRITERIA - Q2 TECHNOLOGY PROCUREMENT EXERCISE
quests.hint: Selection process and purpose are in the subject; the team is addressed; four criteria with specific percentage weightings are given in the body; CPO signs formally.
quests.explanation: Providing weighted criteria - and ensuring they sum to 100% - demonstrates a rigorous, fair selection process. This approach is also essential for transparency if unsuccessful suppliers later challenge the selection decision.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a supplier informing them that a contract is due for renewal.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
HANNA SHAW, CPO
I WISH TO NOTIFY YOU THAT OUR CURRENT SERVICE AGREEMENT SA-441 EXPIRES ON 31 MARCH AND I WOULD LIKE TO OPEN DISCUSSIONS ABOUT RENEWAL TERMS AND ANY PROPOSED CHANGES TO THE SERVICE SCOPE.
SUBJECT: CONTRACT RENEWAL NOTICE - AGREEMENT REF: SA-441 EXPIRES 31 MARCH
DEAR ACCOUNT MANAGER,
quests.hint: Renewal notice and contract reference are in the subject; the account manager is addressed by role; expiry date, specific agreement, and scope for renegotiation are in the body; CPO signs with abbreviation.
quests.explanation: Notifying a supplier about contract renewal proactively - before the expiry date - allows time for commercial negotiation rather than a rushed renewal on old terms. Flagging interest in 'changes to scope' signals this will be a substantive negotiation.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a sustainability board presenting an environmental impact report.
options: I AM PLEASED TO PRESENT OUR 2024 ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT, WHICH SHOWS A 22% REDUCTION IN CARBON EMISSIONS, ACHIEVEMENT OF OUR 2024 RENEWABLE ENERGY TARGET, AND ZERO LANDFILL FOR THE SECOND CONSECUTIVE YEAR.

YOURS SINCERELY,
GEORGE WALSH, SUSTAINABILITY DIRECTOR
DEAR SUSTAINABILITY COMMITTEE,
SUBJECT: ANNUAL ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT 2024 - CARBON REDUCED BY 22%
quests.hint: Headline metric and report type are in the subject; the committee is addressed formally; three specific environmental achievements are in the body; sustainability director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Three specific, measurable environmental achievements - carbon reduction, renewable target, and zero landfill - make a much more credible sustainability report than vague commitments. Each metric demonstrates progress against a different environmental pillar.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a leadership team proposing carbon reduction targets for the next five years.
options: I AM PROPOSING THAT THE COMPANY ADOPTS A NET ZERO CARBON TARGET BY 2035, UNDERPINNED BY ANNUAL 15% REDUCTIONS FROM 2025 ONWARDS AND VERIFIED BY AN INDEPENDENT THIRD PARTY.
DEAR EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE,

YOURS SINCERELY,
GEORGE WALSH, SUSTAINABILITY DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: CARBON REDUCTION TARGET PROPOSAL - NET ZERO BY 2035
quests.hint: Target and year are in the subject; the executive committee is addressed; net zero deadline, annual reduction rate, and third-party verification are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: Three elements make a credible net zero commitment: the target date ('2035'), the pathway ('15% annual reduction'), and verification mechanism ('independent third party'). Without all three, it is a pledge without substance.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to suppliers introducing new environmental compliance requirements.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
GEORGE WALSH, SUSTAINABILITY DIRECTOR
FROM Q1 2025, ALL SUPPLIERS TO NEXUS CONSULTING MUST PROVIDE AN ANNUAL CARBON AUDIT REPORT AND DEMONSTRATE COMPLIANCE WITH OUR UPDATED ENVIRONMENTAL SUPPLY CHAIN STANDARDS.
SUBJECT: NEW ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS FOR ALL SUPPLIERS - EFFECTIVE Q1 2025
DEAR VALUED SUPPLIER,
quests.hint: Compliance type and effective date are in the subject; suppliers are addressed respectfully; two specific new requirements and the timeline are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: Addressing suppliers as 'valued' while setting mandatory requirements ('must provide') strikes the right tone - firm but respectful. Specifying two concrete requirements means suppliers know exactly what they need to do to remain on the approved list.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a board presenting a market entry strategy for a new geographic region.
options: I AM PRESENTING OUR PROPOSED ENTRY STRATEGY FOR SOUTHEAST ASIA, WHICH RECOMMENDS A PHASED APPROACH BEGINNING WITH SINGAPORE AS A HUB MARKET BEFORE EXPANDING TO INDONESIA AND VIETNAM IN YEAR TWO.

YOURS SINCERELY,
CLARE JAMES, STRATEGY DIRECTOR
DEAR STRATEGY BOARD,
SUBJECT: MARKET ENTRY STRATEGY - SOUTHEAST ASIA EXPANSION PLAN
quests.hint: Region and strategy type are in the subject; the board is addressed formally; phased approach, hub market, and year two targets are in the body; strategy director signs with role.
quests.explanation: A market entry strategy email to the board needs to convey the logic quickly: a hub-and-spoke model starting with Singapore before expanding is a risk-managed approach that the board can immediately visualise. Details go in the attached strategy document.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email briefing a country management team on a new market entry plan.
options: I AM PLEASED TO CONFIRM THAT OUR SINGAPORE MARKET LAUNCH WILL PROCEED ON 1 JUNE - THE TEAM BRIEF DECK IS ATTACHED AND I WOULD LIKE ALL TEAM LEADERS TO REVIEW IT BEFORE OUR FRIDAY CALL.
DEAR SINGAPORE LAUNCH TEAM,

BEST REGARDS,
CLARE JAMES, STRATEGY DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: SINGAPORE MARKET ENTRY BRIEFING - LAUNCH DATE CONFIRMED AS 1 JUNE
quests.hint: Location and launch date are in the subject; the country team is addressed; launch confirmation, attachment, and action deadline for team leaders are in the body; director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Combining the launch confirmation with a specific action ('review the deck before Friday') and a purpose ('Friday call') creates a clear sequence: confirm → review → discuss. This prevents the briefing from being passive.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email requesting a country risk assessment before entering a new market.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
CLARE JAMES, STRATEGY DIRECTOR
AHEAD OF OUR YEAR TWO EXPANSION INTO INDONESIA AND VIETNAM, WE REQUIRE FORMAL COUNTRY RISK ASSESSMENTS COVERING POLITICAL STABILITY, REGULATORY ENVIRONMENT, AND CURRENCY RISK.
SUBJECT: COUNTRY RISK ASSESSMENT REQUEST - INDONESIA AND VIETNAM EXPANSION
DEAR RISK MANAGEMENT TEAM,
quests.hint: Countries and assessment purpose are in the subject; the risk team is addressed; expansion context and three specific risk categories are requested in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: Requesting three specific risk categories - political, regulatory, and currency - ensures a comprehensive assessment rather than one that covers only the most visible risk. Each category addresses a different dimension of market entry risk.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to all staff sharing the results of an anonymous employee survey.
options: THANK YOU TO THE 87% OF STAFF WHO COMPLETED THE EMPLOYEE SURVEY - THE KEY THEMES ARE CAREER DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES, WORK-LIFE BALANCE, AND TEAM COMMUNICATION, WHICH WE WILL PRIORITISE IN OUR ACTION PLAN.

BEST REGARDS,
HR DIRECTOR
DEAR ALL,
SUBJECT: EMPLOYEE SURVEY RESULTS - KEY THEMES AND NEXT STEPS
quests.hint: Survey type and purpose are in the subject; all staff are addressed; participation rate, three top themes, and commitment to an action plan are all in the body; HR director signs.
quests.explanation: Sharing the participation rate ('87%') validates the survey's credibility and acknowledges staff contribution. Committing to an action plan rather than simply reporting results is what transforms a survey from a tick-box exercise into a genuine engagement tool.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a wellbeing committee proposing new employee wellbeing initiatives.
options: I AM PROPOSING THREE NEW WELLBEING INITIATIVES FOR Q2 LAUNCH: A MENTAL HEALTH FIRST AIDER NETWORK, FLEXIBLE WORKING POLICY EXTENSION, AND A SUBSIDISED GYM MEMBERSHIP SCHEME.
DEAR WELLBEING COMMITTEE,

BEST REGARDS,
SARAH GRANT, HR DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: WELLBEING INITIATIVE PROPOSAL - THREE PROGRAMMES FOR Q2 LAUNCH
quests.hint: Number of initiatives and timeline are in the subject; the committee is addressed; three specific wellbeing programmes are named in the body; HR director signs with role.
quests.explanation: Three concrete programme names - mental health, flexible working, subsidised gym - give the committee a clear, visualisable package to evaluate. The Q2 timeline provides the urgency needed for a committee decision.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to senior leaders presenting an employee engagement strategy.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
SARAH GRANT, HR DIRECTOR
I AM PRESENTING A THREE-PILLAR EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT STRATEGY TARGETING AN 80% ENGAGEMENT SCORE BY YEAR END, ENCOMPASSING CAREER DEVELOPMENT, LEADERSHIP COMMUNICATION, AND REWARDS AND RECOGNITION.
SUBJECT: EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT STRATEGY - TARGETING 80% ENGAGEMENT BY YEAR END
DEAR LEADERSHIP TEAM,
quests.hint: Target and strategy type are in the subject; leadership is addressed; engagement target, three pillars, and timeline are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: A three-pillar framework - career development, leadership communication, and recognition - covers the three most evidence-based drivers of employee engagement. Setting an '80% engagement score' target gives leaders a specific, measurable outcome to hold HR accountable to.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to all senior staff announcing the annual strategy review cycle.
options: I AM WRITING TO LAUNCH THIS YEAR'S ANNUAL STRATEGY REVIEW - EACH DEPARTMENT IS REQUESTED TO SUBMIT ITS STRATEGIC OBJECTIVES AND BUDGET REQUIREMENTS FOR 2025 BY 30 NOVEMBER.

BEST REGARDS,
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
DEAR HEADS OF DEPARTMENT,
SUBJECT: ANNUAL STRATEGY REVIEW - SUBMISSIONS REQUIRED BY 30 NOVEMBER
quests.hint: Review process and deadline are in the subject; heads of department are addressed by role; process launch, two submission requirements, and deadline are in the body; CEO signs by role.
quests.explanation: Addressing 'Heads of Department' by role rather than individually when sending a company-wide request is standard in large organisations. Two clear deliverables - 'objectives AND budget requirements' - prevent departmental heads from submitting incomplete information.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a management team presenting updated annual strategic objectives.
options: PLEASE FIND ATTACHED THE UPDATED STRATEGIC OBJECTIVES FOR 2025, INCORPORATING DEPARTMENT INPUT FROM THE ANNUAL REVIEW - KEY PRIORITIES ARE REVENUE GROWTH, TALENT RETENTION, AND TECHNOLOGY TRANSFORMATION.
DEAR MANAGEMENT BOARD,

YOURS SINCERELY,
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
SUBJECT: 2025 STRATEGIC OBJECTIVES - UPDATED FRAMEWORK FOR BOARD APPROVAL
quests.hint: Year and update purpose are in the subject; the board is addressed formally; attachment, process acknowledged, and three headline priorities are in the body; CEO signs by role.
quests.explanation: Acknowledging that department input was incorporated ('incorporating department input') validates the review process. Three strategic priorities give the board a clear picture without requiring them to read the full document before approval.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email presenting a department's performance against annual objectives to senior management.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
CHRIS FORD, OPERATIONS DIRECTOR
I AM PLEASED TO REPORT THAT THE OPERATIONS DEPARTMENT ACHIEVED OR EXCEEDED ALL FIVE OF ITS 2024 STRATEGIC OBJECTIVES, WITH OUTSTANDING PERFORMANCE IN COST MANAGEMENT AND PROCESS EFFICIENCY.
SUBJECT: OPERATIONS DEPARTMENT - 2024 ANNUAL PERFORMANCE vs OBJECTIVES
DEAR EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE,
quests.hint: Department and performance context are in the subject; the executive committee is addressed formally; achievement level, number of objectives, and two highlight areas are in the body; director signs formally.
quests.explanation: Reporting that ALL five objectives were achieved ('all five') is the critical headline. Highlighting two outstanding areas ('cost management, process efficiency') adds depth without requiring the committee to read the full report to understand the best results.
